A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''mother of Nella Bold'''. She was married to [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Orin Bold]], and was killed by [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrips]] when [[Nella Bold]] was still young.
